sql_templates: WITH recent_flows AS (SELECT trade_date, fii_net_5d, dii_net_5d, flow_signal FROM signals.fii_dii_flows WHERE trade_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 day'),
recent_regimes AS (SELECT trade_date, regime, confidence FROM signals.regime_history WHERE trade_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 day'),
recent_breadth AS (SELECT trade_date, ad_signal, ad_oscillator, market_sentiment FROM breadth.market_daily WHERE trade_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 day'),
recent_index AS (SELECT trade_date, index_symbol, close, trend_signal FROM market.index_eod WHERE trade_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 day')

SELECT rf.trade_date, rf.flow_signal, rr.regime, rr.confidence, rb.ad_signal, rb.market_sentiment, ri.trend_signal FROM recent_flows rf JOIN recent_regimes rr ON rf.trade_date = rr.trade_date JOIN recent_breadth rb ON rf.trade_date = rb.trade_date JOIN recent_index ri ON rf.trade_date = ri.trade_date ORDER BY rf.trade_date DESC;
